verdict.rationale: A real hands-on probe shows the documented single-command `npx skills add ... --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy` non-interactively fetches, installs, and verifies a working skill file in one shot, matching the docs' promise of a fast, no-fork install; this is corroborated by first-party docs on `npx skills update` and the official Claude Code marketplace install path. Missing for 10: an explicit stopwatch-style benchmark confirming the 'under five minutes' claim and any independent (non-probe) user account of onboarding speed.
